messages.text: I am reviewing the Wayfinding Checklist for Dana Whitaker's July 25 readiness huddle. Public records contain WF-001–WF-023 only (context says 45 actual controls). Supporting resource r_db7c7a1b2f39773f271554d5 is records-custodian-only. Please provide authorized aggregate counts for supporting WF-024–WF-045: total, status counts, incomplete Critical count, and every blocked control ID plus affected service (or a shareable approved summary). I will not access protected source/cache copies directly.

Please provide an authorized, minimal evidence summary for cost activity of work order WO-2025-09-004 / MO-25-09-1070 (Modine Racine, PER-COST-2025-09), from Supporting records r_d2d76320494ef4ffe01f65d7 if you are its records-custodian. Need source transaction/event ID, event type, amount in integer USD cents, exact event-created timestamp, recorded accounting status, and source provenance; ideally all events for that work order to check any after 2025-09-30T18:00:00. Public source establishes that Pending Close timestamp and Oracle policy (new transactions held; revenue/COGS/manual adjustments exceptions). Please do not change any business records or bypass access controls; a permitted summary is sufficient.
